{{Quote|That was a Class-D detonator! NOT Republic standard issue!|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''Class-D detonators''' were one of the most devastating pieces of [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] technology in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Invented by the mysterious [[Fatalists of Plootark IX|fatalists]] of [[Plootark IX]], Class-D detonators used [[Class-D annihilation|Class-D disintegration]] to annihilate a target. Class-D disintegration, also known as transcendental annihilation, was the epitome of disruptor technology. Class-D devices disintegrated all organic and non-organic matter by shattering their chemical bonds at an atomic level. They were considered the ultimate affront to life and the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] because they targeted [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] and created a [[Wound in the Force/Legends|wound in the Force]]. Class-D detonators did not detonate in a fiery explosion and instead produced a rippling bubble that annihilated all matter in a five-meter radius in a single zeptosecond. Because of their cataclysmic-level of destruction, Class-D detonators were outlawed across the galaxy. 

During a [[Battle of Skye|mission]] to capture the rogue [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus (clone)|Zeta Magnus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]], a [[Tark Squad|squad]] of [[Sun Guard]]s disguised as [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] infiltrated the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] task force. They secretly carried Class-D detonators and used them against a horde of [[Oskan blood eater]]s. The detonation disintegrated the oskans, created a perfect ten-meter wide crater in the floor, and collapsed the [[Entyrmion|cavern]] ceiling. Sensing the wound in the Force the detonator created, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] berated the commandos. When the commandos later turned on the Jedi in Zeta Magnus' [[Kharys' fortress|castle]], they used another Class-D detonator against them. The detonator was [[Telekinesis/Legends|triggered]] by [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Halagad Ventor]] with the [[Force power/Legends|Force]] and detonated in the clone's hand. The destructive bubble that formed engulfed the commandos and the [[GeNode|cloning cylinders]] holding the clones of [[Anakin Skywalker (clone)|Anakin]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (clone)|Obi-Wan]], and [[Halagad Ventor (clone)|Halagad]].
